operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and README.md: pause writes and hourly scheduled work, retain the exact source and private configuration, export the installation, restore into fresh empty resources with a new owner, re-export and compare domain data before routing traffic. Preserve all applied migration names and bytes.
